title: BUR to Brickell
body: Flew BUR–DEN–MIA and checked into AC Hotel Brickell for a few nights on the bay.

title: Dinner on the water
body: First Miami dinner at Crazy About You.

title: Big Bus day
body: A Big Bus ticket around Miami — an easy way to see the city before we boarded.

title: Key West
body: A day trip down to Key West, then back to Brickell.

title: On the Lady
body: Boarded Virgin Voyages Brilliant Lady at PortMiami — eleven nights, Southern Caribbean & Aruban Nights. Late afternoon sail-away.

title: Southbound
body: First full day at sea. The meals that stuck later: The Test Kitchen and Pink Agave.

title: Still water
body: Another sea day, still heading south.

title: Oranjestad
body: Morning into Oranjestad. A day on Aruba, then back aboard.

title: Toward Colombia
body: A sea day between Aruba and Cartagena.

title: In for the night
body: Cartagena in the morning. The Lady stayed overnight.

title: Last light in port
body: A second day in Cartagena. Afternoon departure.

title: North again
body: At sea, Jamaica next.

title: River and beach
body: Ocho Rios in the morning. Shore Thing: river tubing, rafting, and Bamboo Beach.

title: George Town
body: Morning into George Town. A day on Grand Cayman.

title: Last night on the Lady
body: Sea day back toward Miami.

title: Off the Lady
body: Disembarked Brilliant Lady in Miami at first light.

title: One night ashore
body: Overnight at Travel Inn Riviera Beach, between ships.

title: On Paradise
body: Boarded Margaritaville at Sea Paradise at Port of Palm Beach — a three-night Nassau run.

title: A short hop
body: Sea day on Paradise, Palm Beach toward Nassau.

title: Nassau
body: A day in Nassau, then back aboard.

title: West to LAX
body: Off Paradise in Palm Beach. Trip’s end. Home to LAX.
